subject.title: fix(ui): restore Control UI E2E coverage

question: After refreshing the merge result against current `main`, should this Control UI E2E and lifecycle repair be merged?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and only a refreshed merge result can confirm that the coverage updates still match the latest UI structure.

options.title: Refresh and merge
options.body: Rebase or merge-refresh the branch, rerun the focused Control UI browser lane on that exact head, and merge if the reported lifecycle and focus behavior remain covered.

options.title: Request targeted follow-up
options.body: Keep the PR open only if the refresh exposes a concrete regression or stale expectation that needs an additional focused correction.

recommendation.title: Refresh and merge
recommendation.body: Rebase or merge-refresh the branch, rerun the focused Control UI browser lane on that exact head, and merge if the reported lifecycle and focus behavior remain covered.
